title: 第712章 合围大乘境中期邪魔第711章 我还在这呢你们贴得这么亲密
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
她开口是为了让他收敛点，别在她面前和魅魔姐妹花贴得这么肆无忌惮，又不是想让他把自己也给邀进这贴贴的行列中。
若是她真的想加入，自然有无数种方式可以理所当然地占据他身边的任何一个位置。
闻言，江尘羽则是无辜地眨了眨眼睛，但却没有停止贴贴。
开什么玩笑，师尊只是让他收敛点，又不是勒令他立刻松手。
他若是在听到师尊开口的瞬间就条件反射似的把魅魔姐妹花推开，那反而是对清秋和清雨最大的不尊重。
于是他只是略微调整了一下自己双手的位置。
她左手从魔清雨的小腹上移开，算是给了师尊几分面子，但右手却顺着她腰侧的弧线缓缓滑下，然后落在她修长且白皙的大腿上。
江尘羽用邪恶的爪爪在魔清雨那修长且白皙的大腿上缓缓游离着。
他的指尖极轻极缓地在她大腿外侧那片光滑而紧致的肌肤上画着圈，力道轻得如同羽毛拂过水面，却精准地落在大腿内侧那一小片极为敏感的区域，惹得魔清雨的呼吸都乱了几分。
她咬着下唇，用那双眼眸既嗔怪又控诉地望着他，但却没有躲开，只是将身体往他怀里又靠了靠。
除了对魔清雨下手以外，江尘羽还悄悄操控自己的灵力凝聚成了一片羽毛。
那羽毛约莫小指大小，通体呈现出半透明的淡青色，边缘柔软而富有弹性，在空中飘浮时如同一片真正的羽毛般轻盈无声。
他微微偏过头，用余光确认了一下羽毛的位置，然后心念一动，那片灵力羽毛便如同被一阵极细极微的微风托着，羽毛轻轻地顺着江尘羽与魔清秋身躯的缝隙中钻入。
它灵巧地避开了两人身体贴合处的衣物，在魔清秋那平坦的小腹上轻轻撩拨着。
羽毛的边缘极轻极缓地扫过她小腹上那一片极为敏感的肌肤。
那触感若有若无，轻得几乎不可察觉，却因为那份不可察觉而更加撩人心弦。
魔清秋那双妩媚的眼眸骤然睁开，瞳孔深处翻涌起几分意外与惊喜交织的光芒，然后她低下头，凑到江尘羽耳边，发出了只有他才能够听到的悦耳低吟声。
“咳咳！”
估摸着过了十几息，谢曦雪发出了一声轻咳。
那声轻咳不轻不重，却在这片幽暗寂静的洞窟中显得格外清晰。

谢曦雪那双清冷的眼眸里闪过一丝“差不多得了”的警告意味。
闻言，江尘羽也没有继续，那片还贴在魔清秋小腹上的灵力羽毛化为一缕极淡的青色烟雾消散在空气中，没有留下任何痕迹。
他那只还停留在魔清雨大腿上的手也顺势收了回来，转而规规矩矩地垂在身侧。
而魔清秋也很给谢曦雪面子。
她虽然平日里最喜欢拱火，但在这种时候却比谁都识趣。
在女人发出轻咳的瞬间便将自己缠绕在他们身上的尾巴给收回，那条修长而灵活的尾巴从江尘羽腰间松开，又从妹妹腰侧滑过，最后规规矩矩地垂落在她自己身后，尾尖还极轻极快地甩了一下。
那是她意犹未尽却又不得不收敛时才会有的小动作。
她的身体也从江尘羽后背上挪开了几分，将他重新放回可以自由行动的状态，只是那双妩媚的眼眸依旧笑吟吟地望着他，仿佛在无声地说——回头再找你继续贴贴。
“我们继续深入些吧。”
江尘羽活动了一下被抱了许久的肩膀，将方才那些旖旎的念头尽数收敛，重新换上了那副冷静而专注的神情。
他抬起头，将目光投向洞窟深处那片更加幽暗的区域。
即便是以他的目力，也只能隐约看到那片黑暗中翻涌着比外围更加浓郁的魔气，如同一头沉睡在深渊底部的远古凶兽正在缓慢而沉重地呼吸。
他感受着外围残留着的邪魔气息，那些被他们清剿之后残余的魔气碎片正在缓缓向洞窟深处飘去，仿佛被某种无形的力量牵引着回归它们的源头。
闻言，谢曦雪则是蹙了蹙眉头。
虽然这里的魔窟并没有足以威胁到她的邪魔，但这并不意味着这个魔窟就是绝对安全的。
越是靠近那处空间裂隙，魔物的实力就越强，魔气的浓度也越高，空间本身也越不稳定。
content_en:
She opened her mouth to ask him to restrain himself from being so unscrupulous with the succubus sisters in front of her, but she didn't want him to invite her into the process.
If she really wanted to join, there were countless ways to take any position beside him as a matter of course.
Hearing this, Jiang Chenyu blinked innocently, but did not stop posting.
Are you kidding me? Master just asked him to restrain himself, not forcing him to let go immediately.
If he had reflexively pushed the succubus sisters away the moment he heard his master speak, that would be the greatest disrespect for Qingqiu and Qingyu.
So he just slightly adjusted the position of his hands.
She removed her left hand from Mo Qingyu's lower abdomen to give her master some face, but her right hand slowly slid down the arc of her waist, and then landed on her slender and fair thigh.
Jiang Chenyu slowly moved his evil claws on Mo Qingyu's slender and white thighs.
His fingertips traced circles on the smooth and tight skin on the outside of her thigh very lightly and slowly. The force was as light as a feather brushing across the water, but it landed precisely on the small and extremely sensitive area on the inside of her thigh, causing Mo Qingyu's breathing to become confused.
She bit her lower lip and looked at him with her eyes accusingly and accusingly, but she didn't move away, she just leaned her body closer to his arms.
In addition to attacking Mo Qingyu, Jiang Chenyu also secretly controlled his spiritual power to condense into a feather.
The feather was about the size of a little finger, and its entire body was translucent light cyan. Its edges were soft and elastic, and it was as light and silent as a real feather when floating in the air.
He tilted his head slightly and used his peripheral vision to confirm the position of the feather. Then with a thought, the spiritual feather seemed to be held by a tiny breeze, and the feather gently slipped into the gap between the bodies of Jiang Chenyu and Mo Qingqiu.
It deftly avoided the clothes where the two bodies were touching, and gently teased Mo Qingqiu's flat belly.
The edge of the feather swept over the extremely sensitive skin on her lower abdomen very lightly and slowly.
The touch was vague and almost imperceptible, but it was even more sultry because of its imperceptibility.
Mo Qingqiu's charming eyes suddenly opened, and a hint of surprise and surprise surged in the depths of her pupils. Then she lowered her head, leaned close to Jiang Chenyu's ear, and let out a sweet murmur that only he could hear.
"Ahem!"
After an estimated ten breaths, Xie Xixue let out a light cough.
The cough was neither light nor heavy, but it was particularly clear in this dark and silent cave.
A hint of "almost done" flashed in Xie Xixue's cold eyes.
Hearing this, Jiang Chenyu did not continue. The piece of spiritual feather that was still attached to Mo Qingqiu's belly turned into a wisp of very light blue smoke and dissipated in the air, leaving no trace.
His hand, which was still on Mo Qingyu's thigh, was retracted and then hung neatly by his side.
And Mo Qingqiu also gave Xie Xixue face.
Although she usually likes to make fire, at this time she is more knowledgeable than anyone else.
The moment the woman let out a light cough, she retracted her tail that was wrapped around them. The slender and flexible tail was released from Jiang Chenyu's waist, slid past her sister's waist, and finally fell neatly behind her, with the tip of the tail flicking very lightly and quickly.
That was a little move she made when she still had something to say but had to restrain herself.
She also moved her body away from Jiang Chenyu's back a little, putting him back in a state where he could move freely, but her charming eyes were still looking at him with a smile, as if she was saying silently - I'll come back to you and continue to cling.
"Let's go deeper."
Jiang Chenyu moved his shoulders, which had been hugged for a long time, and collected all those charming thoughts just now.He calmed down and regained his calm and focused expression.
He raised his head and cast his gaze towards the darker area deep in the cave.
Even with his eyesight, he could only vaguely see that the darkness was filled with more intense demonic energy than the surrounding area, like an ancient ferocious beast sleeping at the bottom of the abyss breathing slowly and heavily.
He felt the evil aura remaining in the periphery. The remaining demonic aura fragments that had been wiped out by them were slowly drifting deeper into the cave, as if being pulled back to their source by some invisible force.
Hearing this, Xie Xixue frowned.
Although there are no demons in the devil's cave here that can threaten her, it does not mean that this devil's cave is absolutely safe.
The closer you get to that space rift, the stronger the monster becomes, the higher the concentration of the demonic energy, and the more unstable the space itself becomes.
